name: combustion_chamber
title: Generic combustion chamber (TESPy CombustionChamber)
summary: Steady-flow combustion chamber translated from TESPy: methane (diluted with CO2, blended with H2) burned with air, mandatory equations = mass balance, pressure equality, one stoichiometry equation per fluid and the lower-heating-value energy balance; returns the fuel flow, the flue-gas composition and the flue-gas temperature for a given air flow and excess-air ratio lambda, with the pressure ratio pr and heat dissipation eta of the diabatic variant.

authors: Francesco Witte (TESPy lead developer) and the TESPy contributors
origin.course: TESPy component CombustionChamber and DiabaticCombustionChamber (commit 19425523); verification against tests/test_components/test_combustion.py and tests/test_models/test_CGAM_model.py (cgam-ebsilon-results.csv)

verification.reference: TESPy runs of the source (local snapshot ~/git/tespy commit 19425523, throw-away venv with CoolProp 8.0.0, TESPy 0.11.3.dev0): 5 cases - test_CombustionChamberHighTemperature, both steps of test_CombustionChamber, the CombustionChamber docstring example and the combustion chamber of the CGAM model compared with tests/test_models/cgam-ebsilon-results.csv; work scripts run_tespy.py, run_cgam.py and verify.py (README, Verification)
verification.notes: Base case also compared with tools/compare_solution.py against tespy_case_A.csv: 15 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001), maximum relative deviation 9.74e-06 on T_fg_K, all other variables <= 1.6e-13 (x_fg_O2 = 1.1e-15 in absolute value). Maximum over the 5 cases 2e-04 (CGAM, T_fg_K 1520.306 K against 1520.000 K); 6.4e-05 for the four component cases. Deviation cause: the two tools use different ideal-gas enthalpy data (CoolSolve NASA-Glenn species against CoolProp 8.0.0 in TESPy); the formation enthalpies agree (LHV_CH4 identical to 14 digits), so only the temperature that follows from the energy balance is affected. Against the Ebsilon table of the CGAM benchmark: 1.4e-03, TESPy's own run deviates by 1.3e-03 (test tolerance 5e-03).

history.action: added (T-TRANSLATE of the TESPy CombustionChamber / DiabaticCombustionChamber, card C-184, inventory row TSP-022); verified against 5 TESPy runs
